name: self-discovery
context: Novel problems where no single fixed reasoning strategy works; the agent discovers and composes its own reasoning structure from a catalogue of modules before solving.
benefits: Outperforms fixed chains on diverse benchmarks
Discovered structures transfer across model families (10-40x cheaper than per-model ensembles)
tradeoffs: Harder to debug than fixed chains
avoid_when: Task family is homogeneous (use a fixed chain)
The task structure is known at design time and unlikely to change
anti_patterns: No fallback when structure discovery produces invalid output
design_principles: Cache selected structures per task type
best_practices: Maintain 30-40 diverse reasoning modules for comprehensive coverage
Validate structure quality (87.5% accuracy means ~12.5% bad structures need catching)
references: Zhou et al., Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures, 2024 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03620
